what: weekly (Fri) trailing P/S per ticker; the same numbers as the median in multiple_v2.json
method: weekly (Fri) trailing P/S = (price[PIT] * shares[PIT]) / TTM_revenue[PIT identity] per ticker -> universe median (>=8 tickers) -> expanding robust z (median/MAD, min 52 weeks)

sources.shares: app/data/v2/facts (SEC XBRL companyfacts, PIT by filed date; tag in last.shares_tag)
